full_track.tags: Orchestral film score with a focus on strings and woodwinds. The piece features a prominent violin melody supported by a full string section, flute, oboe, and French horns. The arrangement utilizes staccato string ostinatos and legato woodwind counter-melodies. A grand piano provides harmonic support with arpeggiated figures. The percussion is minimal, consisting of subtle timpani rolls and occasional orchestral chimes. The tempo is approximately 120 BPM in 4/4 time, modulating through various major keys with a cinematic, sweeping arrangement style. The piece concludes with a solo piano motif followed by a final orchestral swell.
